info.name: Demand Accounts Target Group Allocations API

params.name: business_unit_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the business unit.

params.name: locale
params.description: Filter results by the specified locale code.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a specific account allocation template, which defines supplier rules for a given business unit and locale.
The template includes rules for `open_exchange_allocations` and lists any `blocked_suppliers` from private exchanges if the business unit has private deals.

info.name: Fetch a global allocation template for a business unit and locale

params.name: business_unit_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the business unit.

params.name: locale
params.description: Filter results by the specified locale code.

items.docs: This endpoint will return a global allocation specification template based on a template id, business unit id and locale.  This specification are set for the open exchange suppliers and will also return all the private exchange suppliers within the blocked suppliers group, if the business unit have any private deals.

params.name: business_unit_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the business unit.

params.name: locale
params.description: Filter results by the specified locale code.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the system's default allocation template for a given business unit and locale. This template acts as the ultimate fallback if no specific account or global template is defined. The response includes rules for `open_exchange_allocations` and lists any` blocked_suppliers` from private exchanges.

params.name: project_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the project, in ULID format.

params.name: target_group_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the target group, in ULID format.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the supply allocation for a target group. You can use it to see which suppliers are blocked, how suppliers are grouped, and their minimum and maximum allocation percentages.

params.name: project_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the project, in ULID format.

params.name: target_group_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the target group, in ULID format.

items.docs: This endpoint updates the supply allocation for a target group. You can set which suppliers are blocked, define supplier groups, and configure their minimum and maximum allocation percentages.
